feature: Marketing rebuild Part 8 -- /retainers (Design/design_handoff_marketing/Marketing Retainers.dc.html). The design mock's four illustrative tiers (Advisory/Essentials/Growth/Enterprise at $900/$1,500/$3,000/$5,500, 5/8/16/30 hrs, Essentials 'most popular') do not match the real catalog. The page reads the live retainer tiers from GET /api/services?type=retainer (seeded in artifacts/api-server/src/lib/seed-portal.ts) via useCatalog() -- three tiers only (Architect Essentials $1,500/10hrs, Architect Growth $3,000/25hrs highlighted 'Most Popular', Architect Enterprise $5,500/50hrs), no hardcoded name/price/hours/badge in the component.
notes: Public marketing page, no auth required.

Ordering: GET /api/services?type=retainer is server-ordered ASC by sortOrder (public-services.ts), so index [0]/[1]/[2] are stable as Essentials/Growth/Enterprise per the seed's sortOrder 0/1/2 -- safe to extract by index rather than a jsonPath filter expression.

API1/API2/API3 extract the real name+price for each tier; RP2/RP4/RP6 assert the DOM tier cards show exactly what the API returned, so a page that reverted to the design mock's hardcoded four-tier copy (or stale hours/price) fails here.

RP5 asserts the 'Most Popular' badge renders on the Growth card specifically -- this is the discrepancy the task flagged (mock highlights Essentials as most-popular; the real highlighted/badged tier is Growth), so this assertion is the regression guard against silently reverting to the mock's highlight target.
This manifest asserts against {{DEPLOY_URL}} -- only reflects this commit once the marketing site is redeployed.

apiTests.name: API1 -- the live retainer catalog returns real tiers; take tier[0]'s name+price (expected Architect Essentials).
API2 -- tier[1] (expected Architect Growth, the highlighted/'Most Popular' tier).
